==Description== <!--T:11-->

<!--T:2-->
Exports the current camera properties to a pov-file for use in a POV-Ray project.

==Usage== <!--T:3-->

<!--T:10-->
# Make sure that the view is set to [[Std_PerspectiveCamera|perspective view]]
# Choose {{KEY|Raytracing}}  →  {{KEY|Utilities}}  →{{KEY|[[Image:Raytracing_WriteCamera.svg|32px]] Export camera to POV-Ray...}}  from the top menu.
